errors.evidence: The description states that the harvested area (orange bars) ranges between approximately 1600 and 2100 hectares. While the minimum is correct (approx. 1600), the maximum value is incorrect as the chart shows values reaching approximately 2250 hectares in 2015, which is outside the stated range.

The description identifies 2020 as the year with the highest harvested area (orange bars). According to the chart, the highest value for the orange bars is in 2015 (approximately 2250 hectares), not 2020 (approximately 2150 hectares).
